verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Netlify has dashboard AI agents that fix and ship code using project context, a docs chatbot that answers questions about Netlify, and performance and visitor analytics. None of these documents AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from the user's own data inside the product. The agent and chatbot features are adjacent capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
